value.title: Missing Kings
value.synopsis: Ever since the School Island Incident, in which the four Kings were involved, the Silver Clansman, Kurou Yatogami and Neko have been searching for their master Shiro. Unable to find any leads to Shiro, the two have been in a gloomy mood until they run into Homura members, Rikio Kamamoto and Anna Kushima, who are apparently being chased by someone...
